entries.description: Triple Shine Grape is an Ownist ready-to-drink beauty supplement built around Belight, niacin (vitamin B3), and vitamin C. The source page positions the grape packet format for daily use without powders or water, with organic grape concentrate for flavor.
entries.pdp_how_to_use_raw: No messy powders or water are needed. Sip the ready-to-drink packet daily wherever and whenever it fits your routine.
entries.pdp_ingredients_raw: Belight, Niacin (Vitamin B3), Vitamin C, Organic Agave Syrup, Organic Lemon Concentrate, Locust Bean Gum Powder, Organic Grape Concentrate

pdp_details_sections.heading: Key Ingredients
pdp_details_sections.body: The source page highlights Belight, niacin (vitamin B3), and vitamin C as the three key ingredients in the Triple Shine Grape formula.

pdp_details_sections.heading: Clean and Traceable Ingredients
pdp_details_sections.body: The source page lists Belight as the main ingredient and also names niacin, Vitamin B Group and Vitamin C, organic agave syrup, organic lemon concentrate, locust bean gum powder, and organic grape concentrate.

pdp_details_sections.heading: Daily Use Format
pdp_details_sections.body: The source page describes a ready-to-drink packet format with no powders or water required.

entries.evidence: Ownist Triple Collagen Orange source PDP identifies hydrolyzed marine collagen, elastin, hyaluronic acid, vitamin C, source countries, and directions to enjoy 1-2 packets at least an hour after meals.
entries.description: Triple Collagen Orange is an Ownist ready-to-drink collagen beauty supplement built around hydrolyzed marine collagen, elastin, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin C. The source page positions the orange packet format for daily use without powders or water.
entries.pdp_how_to_use_raw: Enjoy 1-2 packets, best taken at least an hour after meals. Can be taken anytime. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Refrigeration is optional.
entries.pdp_ingredients_raw: Hydrolyzed Marine Collagen, Elastin, Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin C, Organic Orange Juice Concentrate, Organic Fructooligosaccharide

pdp_details_sections.heading: Highlighted Formula
pdp_details_sections.body: The source page identifies hydrolyzed marine collagen, elastin, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin C as source-backed formula highlights.

pdp_details_sections.heading: Sourcing Transparency
pdp_details_sections.body: The source page lists hydrolyzed marine collagen from Nova Scotia, Canada; elastin from Utah, United States; hyaluronic acid from Ansan, South Korea; vitamin C from Scotland, United Kingdom; organic orange juice concentrate from Valencia, Spain; and organic fructooligosaccharide from Iksan, South Korea.

pdp_details_sections.heading: Daily Use Format
pdp_details_sections.body: The source directions say to enjoy 1-2 packets, best taken at least an hour after meals, and to store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
